rows.name: Garbage collection
rows.description: The collector itself - mark, plan, relocate, compact, sweep, and the GC's own thread joins.

rows.name: Allocation
rows.description: Handing out new objects: the runtime's allocation helpers and slow paths.

rows.name: JIT
rows.description: Compiling IL to native code, including tiering and the prestub.

rows.name: TLS / crypto
rows.description: TLS handshakes and record processing, plus hashing and cipher work.

rows.name: Compression
rows.description: Deflate/inflate and the native compression library.

rows.name: Networking
rows.description: Sockets, the async socket engine, and HTTP server request handling.

rows.name: Serialization
rows.description: Turning objects into bytes and back - JSON, protobuf, XML.

rows.name: Locking / synchronization
rows.description: Monitors, mutexes, waits and the contention paths around them.

rows.name: Thread pool / scheduling
rows.description: Dispatching work items, parking and waking workers, and OS context switches.

rows.name: Kernel
rows.description: Kernel code with no more specific category - syscall entry, interrupts, memory management.

rows.name: Runtime (other)
rows.description: Runtime code that is none of the above - type loading, casting helpers, write barriers, PAL.

rows.name: Managed framework
rows.description: Managed code from System.* / Microsoft.* assemblies.

rows.name: Application code
rows.description: Managed code from everything else - your own assemblies and third-party packages.

rows.name: Globalization / text
rows.description: Culture-aware string comparison, collation and normalization, mostly inside ICU.

rows.description: Stubs the runtime generates at run time - precode, call-counting stubs, jump stubs, delegate thunks. Unnamed permanently: this code exists only in memory and no symbol file describes it.

rows.name: Unresolved
rows.description: Frames with no symbol. Fetching symbols (see the settings) usually moves most of this into the categories above.

rows.name: Uncategorized
rows.description: Frames that matched no rule. A large share here means the category rules need extending.
